leader.name: Charlotte Katakuri
leader.text: [When Attacking]/[On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] DON!! 1: Look at 1 card from the top of your opponent's deck. Then, this Leader gains +1000 power during this battle.

cards.name: Charlotte Katakuri
cards.text:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on your field is returned to your DON!! deck, if your Leader has the {Big Mom Pirates} type, add up to 2 DON!! cards from your DON!! deck and rest them.

[On K.O.] Play up to 1 Character card with 8000 power or less from your hand.

cards.name: Charlotte Cracker
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Big Mom Pirates} type, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it. Then, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less.

cards.name: Charlotte Brulee
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Big Mom Pirates} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Charlotte Linlin
cards.text: [On Play] DON!! 4, you may trash 1 card from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards. Then, up to 1 of your opponent's Characters' base power becomes 0 during this turn.

cards.name: Baron Tamago & Pekoms
cards.text: [When Attacking] DON!! 1: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 2000 base power or less.

cards.name: Charlotte Flampe
cards.text: [Your Turn] [On Play] Up to 1 of your [Charlotte Katakuri] cards gains +2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Charlotte Pudding
cards.text:
[Blocker]

[On Play] If the number of DON!! cards on your field is equal to or less than the number on your opponent's field, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Charlotte Anana
cards.text:
If you have a purple "Big Mom Pirates" type Character other than [Charlotte Anana], this Character gains [Blocker].
(After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Charlotte Oven
cards.text:
[Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: Choose a cost and reveal 1 card from the top of your opponent's deck. If the revealed card has the chosen cost, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 3 or less. Then, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Charlotte Perospero
cards.text:
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Choose a cost and reveal 1 card from the top of your opponent's deck. If the revealed card has the chosen cost, draw 1 card and add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Charlotte Smoothie
cards.text:
[Opponent's Turn] [On K.O.] DON!! 1: Play up to 1 {Big Mom Pirates} type Character card with a cost equal to or less than the number of DON!! cards on your opponent's field other than [Charlotte Smoothie] from your hand.

Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: When Two Men Are Fighting the Last Thing I Need Is Some Half-Hearted Assistance!!!!
cards.text:
[Counter] Choose a cost and reveal 1 card from the top of your opponent's deck. If the revealed card has the chosen cost, up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +5000 power during this battle.
[Trigger] Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Cognac Mama-Mash
subTypes: The Four Emperors Big Mom Pirates
cards.text:
[Main] Choose a cost and reveal 1 card from the top of your opponent's deck. If the revealed card has the chosen cost, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 8 or less.
[Trigger] Add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.
